name: Dataset for the BASIS Framework: High-Resolution Spatial, Diurnal, and Hydraulic Fecal Pollution Tracking in Resource-Limited Urban Channels
description:
This dataset contains high-frequency spatial, temporal, and hydraulic measurements collected from two urban natural drainage networks (Malnichara and Goali Chara) and the receiving Surma River in Sylhet, Bangladesh. The data was collected over a four-week dry-weather monitoring campaign to develop and validate the Behavioral-Anthropogenic Synchronization for Inference of Sources (BASIS) framework.
The dataset includes:
Spatial Baseline Data: Geolocations (Latitude/Longitude), urban land-use classifications (e.g., Slum, Residential, Commercial), and baseline Fecal Coliform (FC) concentrations for 62 monitoring stations.
High-Frequency Temporal Data: Hourly and daily measurements of FC (10⁵ CFU/100 mL), Turbidity (NTU), and pH from targeted outfall nodes to capture diurnal and weekly "Anthropogenic Pulses."
Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD₅): 7-day organic loading data (mg/L) from strategic channel outfalls and river transects to quantify the "Organic Stress Gradient" and "Shoreline Plume" effects.
Hydraulic Mass-Balance Data: Detailed open-channel physical parameters (channel width, depth profiles, cross-sectional areas) and flow velocities. This data is coupled with concurrent FC concentrations to calculate steady-state mass-balance closure between engineered household drains and natural receiving channels.
File name: Sylhet_Urban_Drainage_WaterQuality_Dataset.xlsx
Data Structure / Tab Names:
01_Spatial_62_Stations: (Contains: Channel, Date, Time, Mean FC, pH, Turbidity)
02_Hourly_FC_Turbidity_pH: (Contains: Day, Time, Date, FC, pH, Turbidity)
03_Daily_FC_Turbidity_pH: (Contains: Day, Date, FC, pH, Turbidity)
04_River_BOD5_Profile: (Contains: Date, BOD₅)
05_Mass_Balance_Hydraulics: (Contains: Channel/Location, Cross-sectional parameters [Width, Depth/Height, Area], Flow Velocity [V], Discharge [Q_drain, Q_upstream, Q_downstream], and FC Concentrations [C_drain, C_upstream, C_downstream])
06_Average_Channel_Velocity: (Contains: Date, ID, Time, Chainage, Latitude, Longitude, Velocity triplicate, Average velocity)
07_Rainfall: (Contains: Station, Source, Date, Rainfall)
